يستجوبون (form X)
# يَسْتَجْوِبُونَ (yastajwibūna) /jas.tad͡ʒ.wi.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
# يُسْتَجْوَبُونَ (yustajwabūna) /jus.tad͡ʒ.wa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْوَبَ (istajwaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
